session_1.speaker: Kenji
session_1.text: Hey, you almost home? Just wrapped up in lab, trying to decide if I wanna face the T at rush hour or grab coffee first.

session_1.speaker: Amara
session_1.text: Haha, same. Just finished my last call for the day. Stuck in traffic near Central Sq but moving slowly. Probs 20 min out.

session_1.speaker: Kenji
session_1.text: Nice. I'm gonna swing by Tatte for a quick caffeine hit then brave the Red Line. Should be back around 6ish?

session_1.speaker: Amara
session_1.text: Sounds good! I can start thinking about dinner then. My brain is fried from client meetings, anything sound good to you?

session_1.speaker: Kenji
session_1.text: Oh man, rough day for you? Yeah, definitely need something easy. Maybe that pasta dish we made last week? Or takeout from Pavement?

session_1.speaker: Amara
session_1.text: The pasta sounds way better tbh. I've got some veggies we can throw in. Just landed a new referral for next Tues, so def no energy for complicated cooking.

session_1.speaker: Kenji
session_1.text: Awesome, pasta it is! So you're free on Tuesday evenings then? How's your schedule looking for the weekend, btw? Anything fun planned in Cambridge?

session_1.speaker: Amara
session_1.text: Nah, Tues is usually chill, that's why I took the new case. This weekend is wide open so far. Might just chill, maybe hit up Harvard Book Store.

session_1.speaker: Kenji
session_1.text: Jealous. I'm pretty much chained to my bench all Saturday, trying to get these samples ready for sequencing. Biochemistry never sleeps, Amara.

session_1.speaker: Amara
session_1.text: Lol, poor Kenji. Sounds thrilling! Don't forget to eat actual food and not just whatever concoction you're mixing in the lab.

session_1.speaker: Kenji
session_1.text: Hey! My coffee is a scientific concoction, thank you very much. And I *will* have pizza delivery as a reward. You're welcome to join.

session_1.speaker: Amara
session_1.text: Hahaha, deal! Looking forward to that pasta tonight and hearing more about your thrilling biochem life. See ya soon!

session_2.speaker: Kenji
session_2.text: Just got my iced latte from Tatte. You make it home yet? What's the dinner brainstorm looking like?

session_2.speaker: Amara
session_2.text: Yep, just walked in! My brain went straight to 'something easy and delicious.' Thinking maybe that pesto pasta dish we made last week?

session_2.speaker: Kenji
session_2.text: Ooh, the one with the cherry tomatoes and ricotta? I'm SO down for that! My lab brain is totally fried, so easy sounds perfect.

session_2.speaker: Amara
session_2.text: Exactly! I have most of the stuff here. Just need to grab some fresh basil from Star Market. I can swing by in like 15 minutes?

session_2.speaker: Kenji
session_2.text: Sounds good! I'm almost back to the apartment now, navigating the Red Line during rush hour is always a journey.

session_2.speaker: Amara
session_2.text: Lol tell me about it. Just saw a guy try to squeeze onto a packed car at Central with a full-size cello case. Bold strategy.

session_2.speaker: Kenji
session_2.text: Hahaha, classic Cambridge T move. Hope he made it. You'd think after 3 years here, I'd be used to it.

session_2.speaker: Amara
session_2.text: Never fully immune to the T's charms, are we? 😉 Don't worry, pasta power will restore your soul.

session_2.speaker: Kenji
session_2.text: Indeed. You think we have any of that sourdough left from Flour Bakery? Would be perfect for dipping.

session_2.speaker: Amara
session_2.text: Ooh, excellent call! Let me check... yep, still a decent chunk in the bread box! Perfect, I'll slice it when I get back.

session_2.speaker: Kenji
session_2.text: Sweet! I'm unlocking the door now. I'll get the water boiling for the pasta while you're out.

session_2.speaker: Amara
session_2.text: You're the best! Heading out the door now. Be back in a jiffy with the goods.

session_6.speaker: Kenji
session_6.text: Hey, just leaving lab now. The Western Ave bridge traffic is gonna be killer tonight prob. See you in a bit?

session_6.speaker: Amara
session_6.text: Ugh, tell me about it. Just wrapped up my last home visit near Central. Heading back to the apt now. Almost there.

session_6.speaker: Kenji
session_6.text: Cool. You thinking about dinner? I'm starving. My glucose experiment took way longer than expected today.

session_6.speaker: Amara
session_6.text: Yeah def! Was thinking about that new Korean place on Mass Ave. Or super easy: leftovers from that curry we made Sunday?

session_6.speaker: Kenji
session_6.text: Hmm, Korean sounds good but I'm beat. Curry is prob the smart move. Less effort. We can save Korean for Friday night.

session_6.speaker: Amara
session_6.text: Deal. I'll just heat it up when I walk in the door. You want the big portion or the small one? I think there's two left.

session_6.speaker: Kenji
session_6.text: Big one for sure. Brain fuel needed after all those data points. Did you manage to get that package from downstairs?

session_6.speaker: Amara
session_6.text: Oh! Almost forgot! Yes, the one from your mom was there. Put it on your desk. She knows you're always forgetting things lol.

session_6.speaker: Kenji
session_6.text: Haha, classic. Thanks for grabbing it! You're the best. Did you catch the Sox score from yesterday?

session_6.speaker: Amara
session_6.text: Nope, not yet! Was too wiped last night. Don't tell me it was another heartbreaking loss after all that extra innings drama from Tuesday.

session_6.speaker: Kenji
session_6.text: Worse. They blew a 3-run lead in the 9th. Brutal. Well, guess we can just chill and watch something tonight then.

session_6.speaker: Amara
session_6.text: Sounds perfect. My brain can't handle any more crises today. See ya in a few.

session_1.speaker: Rosa
session_1.text: Hey love, just leaving the restaurant now. Crazy busy lunch service today, we were slammed until 2pm.

session_1.speaker: Luis
session_1.text: Good to hear! I'm still at that Coral Gables showing. This couple is *really* interested in the house on Galiano.

session_1.speaker: Rosa
session_1.text: Oh nice! Hope it closes for you soon. What are you thinking for dinner tonight? I'm beat.

session_1.speaker: Luis
session_1.text: Yeah, me too. How about we just grab something easy? Or I can pick up that pollo asado from Los Pollos?

session_1.speaker: Rosa
session_1.text: Ooh, Los Pollos sounds perfect. Grab a side of tostones too please! And maybe a small flan if they have it?

session_1.speaker: Luis
session_1.text: Done. I'll call them now so it's ready for pickup. Should be home around 6:30.

session_1.speaker: Rosa
session_1.text: Sounds good. Mateo called earlier, just checking if we saw his email about the family vacation dates for July.

session_1.speaker: Luis
session_1.text: Ah, not yet. I'll take a look once I'm home. Probably right after I drop off these keys.

session_1.speaker: Rosa
session_1.text: K. Let's make sure we decide by the end of the week. You know how quickly those flights book up.

session_1.speaker: Luis
session_1.text: Will do, mi amor. Just left the showing. Traffic looks okay heading south on US-1.

session_1.speaker: Rosa
session_1.text: Great. See you soon then. Don't forget the flan! 😉

session_1.speaker: Luis
session_1.text: Never! Be there in a bit.

session_2.speaker: Rosa
session_2.text: Easy sounds perfect after today. How about that new Peruvian place on Bird? Or just pickup from El Porton?

session_2.speaker: Luis
session_2.text: El Porton sounds good to me. I'm already over near Miracle Mile, so it's on my way. I can grab it.

session_2.speaker: Rosa
session_2.text: Perfect! Get a couple of those chicken empanadas for me too, if they have them. I'm leaving the restaurant now.

session_2.speaker: Luis
session_2.text: Will do! Yeah this Coral Gables showing actually went pretty well. The couple seemed to really like the master suite. Fingers crossed.

session_2.speaker: Rosa
session_2.text: Oh good! That's excellent news. Hopefully it's a solid offer for you soon. Mine was nuts today, we sold out of the lechon before 1pm!

session_2.speaker: Luis
session_2.text: Wow, really? That's amazing, mami! You're gonna need to order more pig lol. Good problem to have though.

session_2.speaker: Rosa
session_2.text: Tell me about it. Thinking about adding an extra prep shift on Thursdays. This is busier than last summer already.

session_2.speaker: Luis
session_2.text: Yeah, I noticed you've been working even later. Don't overdo it, okay? We should definitely celebrate if this Gables deal closes next week.

session_2.speaker: Rosa
session_2.text: Always a good excuse for a celebration! 😉 Just glad to be heading home now. Traffic's already picking up on 8th street.

session_2.speaker: Luis
session_2.text: Ugh, don't remind me. I'm just leaving the showing now. Be home in about 20-25 with dinner.

session_2.speaker: Rosa
session_2.text: Sounds great! See you soon, love. Need anything from the store for breakfast tomorrow?

session_2.speaker: Luis
session_2.text: Nah, I think we're good for tonight and tomorrow morning. See ya!

session_3.speaker: Rosa
session_3.text: ...pretty what? Good I hope! You sound like you're in a hurry.

session_3.speaker: Luis
session_3.text: Yeah, pretty well! The clients loved the modern kitchen. Just signing paperwork now from the car before I head to El Porton.

session_3.speaker: Rosa
session_3.text: Nice! Another sale then, mi amor? That's great for a Tuesday. My day's been a little chaotic, we had a rush at lunch.

session_3.speaker: Luis
session_3.text: Hopefully! Fingers crossed. Aw man, busy day for both of us. At least dinner will be easy. Did you want a soda from El Porton or anything specific?

session_3.speaker: Rosa
session_3.text: Just water for me, thanks! Oh, and don't forget those extra napkins. My hands are still messy from prepping the ceviche for tomorrow's specials.

session_3.speaker: Luis
session_3.text: Gotcha, water and napkins. So ceviche for tomorrow? Sounds delish. Almost there, prob 10 mins out. Traffic's not bad on US-1.

session_3.speaker: Rosa
session_3.text: Perfect! I'm just tidying up the kitchen here now. The kids are still at practice, so it'll just be us for a bit.

session_3.speaker: Luis
session_3.text: Sounds good. Hopefully David remembered his baseball glove this time lol. I'll be home before you know it with those empanadas.

session_3.speaker: Rosa
session_3.text: Haha, hopefully! Can you grab the mail when you come in? It's probably just bills, but still.

session_3.speaker: Luis
session_3.text: Will do! And I'll put my bag down and help you set the table for our Peruvian feast.

session_3.speaker: Rosa
session_3.text: You're the best! Just relax when you get here. I just want to hear about your showing.

session_3.speaker: Luis
session_3.text: Almost at the light on Le Jeune. See you in a few, mami!

session_4.speaker: Rosa
session_4.text: Hey mi amor, still stuck with clients? Hope you get a break soon. What time do you think you'll be done with all that?

session_4.speaker: Luis
session_4.text: Just finished up a call with the buyers from the Coral Gables place. They're making an offer! Big win if it goes through. Heading back to the office now for paperwork.

session_4.speaker: Rosa
session_4.text: Oh wow, that's fantastic news, papi! Congrats! So good for a Tuesday. Should I just warm up leftovers for dinner or do you feel like getting something?

session_4.speaker: Luis
session_4.text: Leftovers sound perfect, mi vida. Probably won't be home much before 7, maybe a bit later. This offer is gonna take a bit to draft.

session_4.speaker: Rosa
session_4.text: No worries at all. I'll just prep the black beans and rice from last night. We have plenty. My shift's almost done anyway. Chef Mario is handling the evening rush.

session_4.speaker: Luis
session_4.text: Good to hear. How was your day at "The Catch" anyway? Any crazy tourists today? Lol. I had to show a couple more places near Pinecrest this afternoon.

session_4.speaker: Rosa
session_4.text: Ha! No crazy tourists, thankfully. Just a super busy lunch. Ran out of the snapper special by 2pm! That's a good problem to have though.

session_4.speaker: Luis
session_4.text: Sounds like it! Glad things are good. Don't forget we need to call about that AC unit later. It's been making a weird noise.

session_4.speaker: Rosa
session_4.text: Oh right! I almost forgot. Maybe we can do it after dinner? I'll set a reminder.

session_4.speaker: Luis
session_4.text: Sounds good. Yeah, don't want it giving out on us with these Miami temps. Anyway, almost at the office. Talk soon.

session_4.speaker: Rosa
session_4.text: Okay, you focus on that offer! I'll see you later. Drive safe.

session_5.speaker: Rosa
session_5.text: Hey mi amor, so excited about those Coral Gables buyers! Everything solid? When's closing?

session_5.speaker: Luis
session_5.text: Yeah, looks really good. Just sent over the final docs for their signatures. Hoping to close by end of next week, maybe the 28th.

session_5.speaker: Rosa
session_5.text: That's awesome! You earned that commission for sure. Just dealing with a new delivery driver here, totally lost lol.

session_5.speaker: Luis
session_5.text: Haha, typical. Hope they figure it out! I'm heading over to check out that new listing in Pinecrest later this afternoon.

session_5.speaker: Rosa
session_5.text: Pinecrest, nice! So you'll be out a bit longer then? Was thinking we could grab a quick bite tonight, not just leftovers.

session_5.speaker: Luis
session_5.text: Yeah, probably. Might be back around 7ish. A quick bite sounds good though, I'm kinda tired of my own cooking for a change. What were you thinking?

session_5.speaker: Rosa
session_5.text: Me too! How about that new Cuban place, 'El Sabor de Abuela'? Just opened last month on 8th street.

session_5.speaker: Luis
session_5.text: Oh, I heard about that! Sounds perfect, mi vida. I'll make a reservation for 7:30 then. Just need to confirm a couple things first.

session_5.speaker: Rosa
session_5.text: Perfect! Let me know if you need me to call instead. I can probably leave the restaurant by 7, 7:15 latest.

session_5.speaker: Luis
session_5.text: Nah, I got it. Just gotta make sure this Pinecrest showing runs smoothly. See you tonight, gorgeous.

session_5.speaker: Rosa
session_5.text: Sounds good, papi. Don't work too hard! Looking forward to it.

session_5.speaker: Luis
session_5.text: You too, mi amor. Will call when I'm leaving Pinecrest. Ciao!

session_6.speaker: Rosa
session_6.text: Hey mi amor, did those Coral Gables docs close today? Still thinking about how hard you worked on that one!

session_6.speaker: Luis
session_6.text: Almost! Buyers signed and wired funds. We should record first thing tmrw morning. Big W, babe!

session_6.speaker: Rosa
session_6.text: OMG! That's fantastic news! You totally earned that commission. So happy for you! Lunch with Leo go well?

session_6.speaker: Luis
session_6.text: Yeah, Leo was good. Just catching up. Said congrats on the closing too haha. How was the restaurant drama today? Any sign of the dishwasher?

session_6.speaker: Rosa
session_6.text: No sign of him. Had to scramble for tonight. Called Maria from last year, she's coming in for the dinner shift. Lifesaver! Prep cook still out tho.

session_6.speaker: Luis
session_6.text: Ugh, what a headache. Glad Maria could help out. You must be wiped. Want me to pick up anything for dinner? Or order from somewhere easy?

session_6.speaker: Rosa
session_6.text: I'm thinking something super simple tonight. Maybe just some takeout from that new place on Bird Rd? Or I can just make a quick pasta if you're too busy.

session_6.speaker: Luis
session_6.text: Nah, I'm done for the day. Text me what you want from Bird Rd and I'll grab it on my way home. So proud of you getting that deal done today btw.

session_6.speaker: Rosa
session_6.text: You're the best! Just two Cuban sandwiches, extra pickles for me, please. And maybe some croquetas if they have them. Thanks mi vida.

session_6.speaker: Luis
session_6.text: Got it. Cuban sandwiches and croquetas it is. Be home in about 45, traffic permitting. See you soon, love you.

session_6.speaker: Rosa
session_6.text: Perfect! Love you too. Don't forget to grab a bottle of that sparkling water we like!

session_6.speaker: Luis
session_6.text: Will do! See ya.

session_1.text: Lol I hear that. Long day with the fur babies?

session_1.speaker: Owen
session_1.text: Dude, yes. Had a tricky bug in the new level build for Orion's Legacy. Took forever to pinpoint. Just wanna veg out.

session_1.text: Ugh, sounds brutal. My day was a lot of puppy vaccinations and one VERY stubborn poodle mix named Buster. He did *not* want his nails trimmed.

session_5.text: Hey, you busy? Just wrapped up a brutal playtest session.

session_5.speaker: Owen

session_5.speaker: Naomi
session_5.text: Probably for the best then. Sometimes you just gotta cut your losses. My afternoon is packed with dog dental cleanings, wish I could scrap those lol.

session_5.speaker: Owen
session_5.text: Ew. Good luck with that. Wanna grab dinner Thursday? My treat, after this whole Level 5 drama finally gets settled. I'm thinking Thai.

session_5.speaker: Naomi
session_5.text: Ooh, Thai sounds amazing! Yeah, Thursday works perfectly, I'm free after 6. Maybe that new place in Bellevue near your old apartment?

session_5.speaker: Owen
session_5.text: The one called 'Spice Alley'? Perfect, I'm down. So glad to be making a concrete decision about this *current* version of Level 5, at least.

session_5.speaker: Naomi
session_5.text: Good. You sounded so stressed about it last time we talked. Glad there's a light at the end of the tunnel for *this* session of the 'Level 5 Saga'.

session_1.speaker: Helena
session_1.text: Hey, how was your day? I just wrapped up the Adams file, finally.

session_1.speaker: Ben
session_1.text: Pretty good! Just finished testing a new sourdough recipe for the blog, so the kitchen smells amazing. You home soon?

session_1.speaker: Helena
session_1.text: Ugh, sounds heavenly. I'm stuck mediating a truly exhausting property dispute, probably another 45 mins here. My brain is soup.

session_1.speaker: Ben
session_1.text: Rough! Take your time. I'll get dinner started. Thinking that lemon herb chicken we like with some roasted veggies? Simple, but good.

session_1.speaker: Helena
session_1.text: Oh, Ben, you're a lifesaver. Yes please, that sounds perfect. How's the draft for your review of 'The Hungry Fox' coming along?

session_1.speaker: Ben
session_1.text: Almost done. Just need to edit a few more photos. Planning to schedule it for Friday morning. Their ramen was surprisingly good, btw.

session_1.speaker: Helena
session_1.text: Nice! I'll definitely check it out. Hey, remind me to call Aunt Carol this weekend. It's her actual birthday on Sunday.

session_1.speaker: Ben
session_1.text: Will do. And don't forget we have our reservation at Sepia on Saturday night for our anniversary dinner, right?

session_1.speaker: Helena
session_1.text: How could I forget?! So excited for that. Can't believe it's been 12 years already. Where does the time even go?

session_1.speaker: Ben
session_1.text: Seriously. Feels like yesterday we were just sharing a greasy pizza after a show on Randolph Street. Time flies when you're having fun, I guess.

session_1.speaker: Helena
session_1.text: Haha, truer words. Anyway, I'm finally packing up now. Be home in about 25. Need anything specific from Mariano's?

session_1.speaker: Ben
session_1.text: Nah, I think we're good. Just you. See ya soon, love. Drive safe.

session_2.speaker: Helena
session_2.text: Finally escaped the Miller mediation! What a marathon. Smells amazing from here btw. 🙏

session_2.speaker: Ben
session_2.text: Glad you're free! Salmon's almost done, asparagus too. Just need to plate. Rough day at the office?

session_2.speaker: Helena
session_2.text: Beyond rough. Two days of back-and-forth on parental allocation for the youngest Miller kids. My head is throbbing. On the brown line now, probably 15 mins out from Loop.

session_2.speaker: Ben
session_2.text: Ugh, the Millers. Hope they got somewhere productive. Good, dinner will be ready when you walk in. Grab a glass of something when you get here, you earned it.

session_2.speaker: Helena
session_2.text: Definitely need wine. And silence. Thinking about just chilling tonight. No plans for the weekend right? Maybe hit up the Lincoln Park farmers market on Saturday?

session_2.speaker: Ben
session_2.text: Sounds perfect. And yeah, nothing firm. Was thinking of doing a quick blog post tomorrow morning about that new sourdough. Maybe test the focaccia recipe for Sunday.

session_2.speaker: Helena
session_2.text: Oh, the sourdough that made the whole place smell like a bakery? Please do! Love that one. We'll need to pick up some good cheese for Sunday too if you're making focaccia.

session_2.speaker: Ben
session_2.text: That's the one! Thinking of calling it 'The Logan Square Levain' on the blog. Got some amazing feedback from my last post on the chili oil. Plus, gotta share those tips.

session_2.speaker: Helena
session_2.text: Haha, nice. Sounds catchy. Remember that time you tried to make chili oil from scratch and almost burned down our old apartment on Division?

session_2.speaker: Ben
session_2.text: Hey! That was ONE time and I was new to the wok. 🤣 Never happened again! Dinner's just about ready btw. See you soon?

session_2.speaker: Helena
session_2.text: Almost home! Just passing Armitage. Be there in 5 tops. Can't wait. So hungry!

session_2.speaker: Ben
session_2.text: Perfect. See you in a few. Got your favorite playlist on.

session_3.speaker: Helena
session_3.text: Productive-ish, for a Miller mediation. We actually got the parenting plan hammered out. Just pulling out of the parking garage now.

session_3.speaker: Ben
session_3.text: Nice! That's definitely a win, given those two. Drive safe. Want a glass of that pinot we opened last night ready when you walk in?

session_3.speaker: Helena
session_3.text: Oh, yes please! That sounds absolutely heavenly. Just gotta swing by CVS for some toothpaste, then straight home. Prob 20 mins.

session_3.speaker: Ben
session_3.text: Gotcha. Dinner's plating soon. Salmon looks perfect, managed to not overcook the asparagus this time haha. Huge achievement.

session_3.speaker: Helena
session_3.text: Haha good job! Any mail today? Or packages? I'm hoping that new kitchen gadget for your 'Gadget Guru' blog series came in.

session_3.speaker: Ben
session_3.text: Nope, no packages today, unfortunately. Just a couple bills. I did get a call from Liam though about the farmer's market next Saturday, wants to feature my beet hummus.

session_3.speaker: Helena
session_3.text: Ooh, that's cool! Which farmer's market? Lincoln Park or Green City?

session_3.speaker: Ben
session_3.text: Green City. He said he has a slot for a quick demo around 10:30am. Could be good for the 'Eat Your Veggies' series too.

session_3.speaker: Helena
session_3.text: Totally! That series is doing so well. Just parked outside CVS now. Be home in 5!

session_3.speaker: Ben
session_3.text: Perfect timing. I'll pour that wine. Almost done with your plate.

session_3.speaker: Helena
session_3.text: Yay! Can't wait. And to finally sit down. So glad to be done with the Millers for the week.

session_3.speaker: Ben
session_3.text: Me too. Just glad you're home. See you in a sec!

session_4.speaker: Helena
session_4.text: Just pulled into the garage. Smells amazing in here already! So ready to be home.

session_4.speaker: Ben
session_4.text: Welcome home! Plates are ready, just waiting for you to shed the lawyer persona 😉 How was the drive through the city?

session_4.speaker: Helena
session_4.text: Not bad actually! Even for a Friday. So glad to be out of these heels. That Miller mediation almost broke me today.

session_4.speaker: Ben
session_4.text: Haha, knew it. But you said it was productive-ish, right? Did they actually agree on anything this time?

session_4.speaker: Helena
session_4.text: Shockingly, yes. At least on the main custody schedule. Had to practically chain them to the table though. So draining.

session_4.speaker: Ben
session_4.text: Wow, congrats on that win then. You def earned this salmon. After dinner, maybe we just crash on the couch and put on that new series?

session_4.speaker: Helena
session_4.text: Yes, please! Sounds perfect. No more legal jargon for me tonight. Need to prep for that client meeting Monday morning though.

session_4.speaker: Ben
session_4.text: Gotcha. Don't forget we've got that farmer's market run planned for Saturday morning. Need to stock up for next week's recipes.

session_4.speaker: Helena
session_4.text: Oh right! And remember we said we'd hit up Logan Square for those artisanal cheeses you wanted too?

session_4.speaker: Ben
session_4.text: Yep! Definitely. I've got a new post brewing for the blog on local Chicago producers, so good excuse to gather some content.

session_4.speaker: Helena
session_4.text: Oh fun! What's the theme this time? More of your experimental sourdough that keeps taking over the fridge?

session_4.speaker: Ben
session_4.text: Haha, not sourdough, surprisingly. Thinking something with the fresh seasonal produce we'll find. Maybe a late summer salad spotlight.

session_1.speaker: David
session_1.text: Hey S! How was your Monday? Crazy at school already?

session_1.speaker: Sandra
session_1.text: lol hey D! Not too bad actually. The kindergarteners were angels. For once! 😂 You? Big bridge problems today?

session_1.speaker: David
session_1.text: Haha, lucky you. Nah, just slogging through permit docs for the new SE Portland interchange. So much paperwork.

session_1.speaker: Sandra
session_1.text: Ugh, sounds thrilling. You heading to that Blazers game on Wednesday night?

session_1.speaker: David
session_1.text: Nah, decided against it. Too tired after work, plus traffic getting downtown is a nightmare. Maybe next week.

session_1.speaker: Sandra
session_1.text: Good call. I'm thinking of trying that new bakery on Division for breakfast this weekend. You in?

session_1.speaker: David
session_1.text: Ooh, the one next to the old movie theater? The one Mom mentioned?

session_1.speaker: Sandra
session_1.text: Yep! "Flour & Fire." Supposed to have amazing croissants. Saturday morning around 9?

session_1.speaker: David
session_1.text: Hmm, Saturday might be tight. Got that volunteer build for Habitat for Humanity. What about Sunday instead?

session_1.speaker: Sandra
session_1.text: Sunday works! I've got that PTA meeting in the afternoon, but morning is free.

session_1.speaker: David
session_1.text: Perfect. So Sunday, 9 AM at Flour & Fire? I'll text Mom too, see if she wants to join.

session_1.speaker: Sandra
session_1.text: Sounds like a plan! I'll make a note. Talk soon!

session_2.speaker: David
session_2.text: Hey S! Yeah, thinking about it. Haven't bought tix yet though. You going?

session_2.speaker: Sandra
session_2.text: Nah, not this one. Got a parent-teacher conference tonight, ugh. Plus, need to prep for the district meeting on Thurs.

session_2.speaker: David
session_2.text: Ah, bummer. District meetings are always fun, right? lol. My project's actually looking good to submit the big report next week.

session_2.speaker: Sandra
session_2.text: Oh, good for you! That's a relief. Meanwhile, I just spent an hour trying to explain why you can't bring a pet ferret to show-and-tell.

session_2.speaker: David
session_2.text: lol A ferret? Seriously? What do parents even think sometimes? Sounds like a wild Tuesday for you.

session_2.speaker: Sandra
session_2.text: Tell me about it. Kid was so proud too. Had to be firm but gentle. Anyway, speaking of things that are 'wild,' did you ever get that new patio furniture for the deck?

session_2.speaker: David
session_2.text: Almost! Ordered it last week, should be here Friday. Hoping for some decent weather this weekend to set it up. Maybe even grill out.

session_2.speaker: Sandra
session_2.text: Oh nice! Fingers crossed for the weather. I'm thinking of checking out that new food cart pod near Revolution Hall on Saturday. Heard it's pretty good.

session_2.speaker: David
session_2.text: Ooh, I heard about that. Let me know how it is! Might drag Mike over there sometime if you give it a thumbs up.

session_2.speaker: Sandra
session_2.text: Will do! Yeah, planning to grab a few things for school there too. Always looking for new snack ideas lol. Anyway, better run, got another call.

session_2.speaker: David
session_2.text: Ok, talk soon then! Good luck with the call and the district meeting!

session_2.speaker: Sandra
session_2.text: Thanks, you too! Catch ya later D.

session_6.speaker: David
session_6.text: Hey, how was your Monday? This rain is something else today. My site visit got soaked.

session_6.speaker: Sandra
session_6.text: Ugh, tell me about it. We had outdoor recess for like 10 minutes then had to pull them all back in. Chaos. How was your site visit, anything interesting?

session_6.speaker: David
session_6.text: Standard stuff. Just inspecting the new bridge decking downtown. They're making good progress, actually ahead of schedule by about a week. Which is rare, haha.

session_6.speaker: Sandra
session_6.text: That's good news! You must be relieved. Remember how stressed you were about that last month? Did you hear back about that grant application for the school's new garden beds?

session_6.speaker: David
session_6.text: Oh yeah, very relieved. Less chasing people around. And no, not yet! Still waiting on the district for the garden grant. Fingers crossed though, it would be awesome for the kids.

session_6.speaker: Sandra
session_6.text: Totally. Speaking of, Liam just told me his class is doing a project on bridges next week. I told him he has a built-in expert uncle if he needs help 😉

session_6.speaker: David
session_6.text: Haha, sounds fun! Tell him to send me his questions. I can totally help him design a popsicle stick bridge or something. My schedule looks pretty clear Thursday evening after 6pm, if he wants to FaceTime.

session_6.speaker: Sandra
session_6.text: Aw, that's sweet of you, I'll pass it on. He'd probably love that. He's really into building things right now. Just finished a huge Lego castle.

session_6.speaker: David
session_6.text: Nice! Sounds like he's following in my footsteps a bit. Just less concrete and more plastic bricks.

session_6.speaker: Sandra
session_6.text: 😂 Definitely. Anyway, I gotta run. Parent-teacher conferences tonight from 4-7pm. Wish me luck for minimal drama.

session_6.speaker: David
session_6.text: Oh yikes, good luck with that! Hope they're all quick and positive. We should probably set up our call for next week soon. Maybe Tuesday evening around 7 like usual?

session_6.speaker: Sandra
session_6.text: Yeah, sounds good. I'll put it in my calendar. Talk soon! xo
